legalName: Motion to Seal a Conviction Record, D.C. Code § 16-806(a)(3)
boundReferenceRole: reference instrument only - the Criminal Division's own instruction sheet, whose verified face grounds the filing-channel steps; it is not included in the packet

routeSelectionsMade.selection: a misdemeanor conviction, for which D.C. Code Sec. 16-806(a)(3) sets a waiting period of five years from completion of the sentence
routeSelectionsMade.statedWhere: in the motion's own paragraph 2, written by this build; no route election is left to the participant on paper

routeSelectionsMade.selection: a felony conviction, for which D.C. Code Sec. 16-806(a)(3) sets a waiting period of eight years from completion of the sentence
routeSelectionsMade.statedWhere: in the motion's own paragraph 2, written by this build; no route election is left to the participant on paper

routeSelectionNote: This family carries two statutory routes and each is rendered as its own fixture pair whose motion states its offense level and waiting period on its face. The participant chooses which VARIANT matches their conviction - a fact about their record, not a route election on the paper - and the instructions say how.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Offence of conviction, worded exactly as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Offence of conviction, worded exactly as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the offence of conviction, worded exactly as the court record words it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement of why sealing this record is in the interests of justice
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of why sealing this record is in the interests of justice
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the recorded legal-design limitation forbids generated individualized interests-of-justice advocacy
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own words on why sealing is in the interests of justice - what the record stops you doing now; the packet does not write advocacy for you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Every citation, arrest, charge and conviction of yours that has not already been sealed or expunged, as reasonably known
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Every citation, arrest, charge and conviction of yours that has not already been sealed or expunged, as reasonably known
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the statute requires the movant's own statement of the history as reasonably known; the platform does not verify it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your record history as reasonably known to you, which D.C. Code Sec. 16-806(c)(1) makes part of the motion - write NONE OTHER if there are none

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Statute section of the offence of conviction, copied from the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Statute section of the offence of conviction, copied from the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the statute section of the offence of conviction, copied from the court record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Prior sealing motions you have filed under this chapter, and when each was resolved
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Prior sealing motions you have filed under this chapter, and when each was resolved

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The records you ask the Court to seal

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the case this motion addresses
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the case this motion addresses

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office for the case
